patch.sql:
select distinct
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The unique_stg_lineitem_order_line_id test failed with 1550 duplicate rows. Raw.lineitem contains duplicate rows that are identical across all columns (e.g., orderkey 871 linenumber 7 appears twice with identical values). According to policy, identical duplicate rows are a batch delivered twice and should be deduplicated in the staging model. Adding SELECT DISTINCT removes the duplicate rows while preserving all columns and types, fixing the uniqueness test without altering data semantics.
